name: Routing — static vs dynamic model discovery
summary: Documentation card: the difference between a connection with a static models[] array vs one with a modelDiscovery endpoint.
description: Static and dynamic AI Gateway connections are the two BYOM routing categories for calling upstream model deployments as `{connection}/{deployment}`. Static connections list exact deployment names in metadata; dynamic connections query the upstream at runtime through `modelDiscovery`.
notes: **Both discovery modes work end-to-end.** See `prompt-agents-static` (static gateway) and `prompt-agents-dynamic` (dynamic gateway) — both are `supported`. Static config lists exact deployment names in the connection metadata; dynamic mode queries the upstream at runtime via `modelDiscovery`.
